halloween-slinky-dog.scene: Maui dressed as Slinky Dog from Toy Story, one complete dog: a soft brown Slinky Dog hood with long floppy brown ears on his head, a green collar, and a shiny metal spring coil wrapped snugly around the middle of his torso like a wide belt of coils, so the coil covers his belly and back while his front legs, rear legs, and fluffy cream tail all belong to the same single body. He stands on all four paws in a happy pose, tail up. Red MAUI bandana visible at the neck above the green collar.
halloween-slinky-dog.revision: v2 per owner feedback (hot dog looked odd, spider too scary, Scooby uncanny, Slinky coil should cover body)

halloween-pumpkin.scene: Maui wearing a plush orange jack-o-lantern pumpkin costume: a round soft pumpkin body wrapped around his torso with a carved smiling face on the belly, and a small green stem-and-leaf cap sitting on top of his head between his floppy ears. He sits upright happily with all four paws showing below the pumpkin, tail out, big smile. Red MAUI bandana visible at the neck.

halloween-dinosaur.scene: Maui wearing a green dinosaur hoodie costume: a soft green hood with cartoon dino eyes on top of his head, a row of darker green triangular spikes running down his back to a stubby dinosaur tail sleeve, and light green belly panel. He stands on all four paws with one front paw lifted in a playful mock roar, mouth open in a happy grin. Red MAUI bandana visible at the neck below the hood.

halloween-hot-dog.scene: Maui wearing a hot dog costume that sits on his back like a saddle, exactly like a store-bought pet hot dog costume: two long puffy tan bun halves running lengthwise along each side of his body from his shoulders to his hips, a plump reddish-brown sausage lying between them along his spine, and a wavy yellow mustard squiggle on top of the sausage. A thin strap passes under his belly. His head, neck, all four legs, and fluffy tail are completely free of the costume. Three-quarter side view, standing on all four paws, looking toward the viewer with a big happy grin. Red MAUI bandana visible at the neck.
halloween-hot-dog.revision: v3: scene rewritten from real product photos (Target/Walmart hot dog saddle, Halloween Express Spider Pup)

halloween-ghost.scene: Maui wearing a soft white ghost cape costume: a fluffy white sherpa cape draped over his back with a wavy scalloped hem and the word BOO stitched in black letters on the side, plus an oversized white ghost hood with two round black eye spots sitting on top of his head so his own face still shows. He sits upright with all four paws visible, tail peeking out from under the cape, big happy smile. Red MAUI bandana visible at the neck.

halloween-spider.scene: Maui wearing a cute fuzzy spider dog costume like a store-bought pet costume: a soft black faux-fur vest over his back, a fluffy black hood sitting on top of his head with three big round white googly eyes on the hood, and eight short soft black plush spider legs with orange fuzzy pom-pom tips sticking out to the sides of the vest, four on each side, drooping playfully. Silly and friendly, not scary. His own smiling cream face shows fully under the hood. Standing on all four paws, tail out. Red MAUI bandana clearly visible at the neck.

halloween-skeleton.scene: Maui wearing a black skeleton hoodie costume: a snug black pullover with glowing white cartoon rib bones and spine printed down the back and sides, and a black hood with a white skull print resting on top of his head so his own face shows. He stands on all four paws in a playful pose, tail out, big happy grin. Red MAUI bandana visible at the neck over the hoodie collar.

halloween-pokemon.scene: Maui wearing a yellow Pikachu hoodie costume: a bright yellow pullover with a yellow hood that has two tall pointed Pikachu ears with black tips, two round red circles on the cheeks of the hood, and a yellow lightning-bolt shaped tail attached at the back. His own face shows under the hood. He sits upright happily with all four paws visible. Red MAUI bandana visible at the neck over the hoodie.

halloween-scooby-doo.scene: Maui wearing a simple Scooby-Doo costume: a soft brown hoodie with two floppy brown hood ears and a few black spots on the back, worn with the hood down around his shoulders so his whole fluffy cream face and floppy ears show clearly, plus a blue collar with a yellow diamond SD tag hanging below his red MAUI bandana. He sits upright with all four paws visible and tail out, big goofy happy smile.

His own face shows under the hood. He sits upright with all four paws visible and tail out, big happy smile. Red MAUI bandana visible at the neck.

He sits upright with all four paws visible and tail out, gentle happy smile, eyes bright. Warm and affectionate, not comedic.
